UP Special TET Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the notification for the Uttar Pradesh Special Teacher Eligibility Test (UP Special TET 2026) Primary and Junior Level. The online application process for UP Special TET Online Form 2026 will start from 05 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 04 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Special TET Online Form 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 03 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 05 September 2026
  • Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 04 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 03 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : Before Exam
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : Notify Later
  • Result : Notify Later

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
